🛠️ Core Features & Mathematical Formulas

Active Features & Analytics Engine Breakdown:
  • 🏈 Position Opportunity Score & WOPR Derivative
    Combines target share, air yards share, rushing share, and offensive snap percentage into a single position-specific opportunity metric normalized between 0.00 and 1.00.
    • WR / TE Opp: 1.2 × Target Share + 0.6 × Air Yards Share + 0.3 × Snap Pct
    • RB Opp: 0.8 × Rushing Share + 1.2 × Target Share + 0.3 × Snap Pct
    • QB Opp: ((Attempts + Carries) / 50) × (0.8 + 0.2 × Snap Pct)
  • ⏱️ Snap Count Share Integration
    Incorporates official offensive snap percentages directly into positional opportunity calculations. Flags players logging high snap participation (≥75%) who are underperforming in fantasy output.
  • 📊 Trailing 3-Week Rolling PPR Average
    Aggregates a player's trailing 3 active games via DuckDB CTE window partitions to guarantee true mathematical rolling averages across all master tables rather than single-week snapshots.
  • 📈 Workload Velocity (Opp Surge)
    Measures the 2-week rate of change in a player's Opportunity Score using DuckDB SQL window functions (`LEAD/LAG`) to detect rapidly expanding or shrinking roles.
    • Surge: Trailing 3-Week Opp Score − Baseline Opp Score (2 Weeks Prior)
  • 🎯 Red Zone & Unrealized Air Yards Buy-Low Index
    Tracks target air yards minus completed air yards along with red zone opportunities (targets, carries, and touchdowns inside the 20) to identify positive regression candidates before market breakouts occur.
  • 📉 Micro-Sparklines (PPR Trends)
    Renders dynamic inline SVG polyline sparklines in master table rows, visualizing game-by-game PPR scoring trajectories across trailing active games.
  • 🗓️ Strength of Schedule (SOS) & Weather Engine
    Ranks opponent defenses by points allowed per position over upcoming 3-game windows (`🟩 EASY`, `🟨 NEUTRAL`, `🟥 TOUGH`) and flags extreme outdoor weather alerts (`💨 Wind ≥15mph`, `🥶 Temp ≤32°F`, `🔥 Temp ≥90°F`).
  • 🏥 Depth Chart Rank & Official IR/Injury Tracking
    Joins official nflreadpy depth chart hierarchies and practice status reports directly to player names, flagging backup volume increases (`SHORT-TERM VOLUME`) or injury statuses (`OUT`, `Q`, `IR`).
  • ⚖️ Streamlined Trade Impact Analyzer
    Interactive modal calculator evaluating proposed multi-player trades by comparing total net Opportunity Score gains/losses and net PPR point differences between managers.
